capability: Publish and inspect governing Charter (usable public view)
notes: Class A/B/C Type O instrument. Free online where lawful publication infrastructure exists; paper/notice still usable where digital publish is not the channel.

capability: Name standing-record opening authority and custodian on the Charter
notes: Surface is the published Charter field, not a separate product.

capability: Inspect and challenge System Classification Record
notes: Public view is Type O for Class A/B/C; challenge under Article XII-B.

capability: Inspect and challenge System Data Types Record
notes: Usable public view without heroic effort; challenge path named.

capability: Inspect and challenge System Certification Record
impl_owner: Ch.7 Part B §11–12; CS-5 evidence packages
notes: Case file plus public view; stay/limit reliance pending contest.

capability: Publish Public Oversight Baseline Disclosure (Type O package)
notes: Paywall of the floor is a failure where lawful online publication exists. Analog-only does not satisfy that online-availability test.

capability: Receive Risk Disclosure
notes: Needed-audience communication; full-fidelity analyses may stay audit-accessible.

capability: Preserve and access evidence for review
notes: Physical and digital; chain of custody. Not a product.

capability: Reconstruct what a system did (Auditability)
notes: Property of reconstructability; CJS-3.3 owns how/when to audit.

capability: Obtain structured or qualified audit access
notes: Non-public is not unreviewable secrecy. Parallel to Type O, not a substitute for it.

capability: Challenge, review, and obtain redress (entry)
notes: Workable path. Analog hearings/notices satisfy; digital is usual but not mandated except where the system already uses digital channels for comparable acts.

capability: File a protected report (whistleblowing)
notes: Must not be defeated by access interference. Channel may be analog.

capability: Receive notice when a standing record opens
notes: Subject must know; delayed notice only on documented Safety/Evidence showing. Silence is the default: do not invent a mandatory standing portal for people with no record.

capability: Inspect own contribution and violation standing records
audience: ordinary sentient (subject); party; auditor; forum participant
notes: Inspectable records. Dashboards are optional tools under §3.5 and must not bury fields in a score.

capability: See challenge path on each standing record
notes: How to challenge, which forum, correction/restoration conditions.

capability: Challenge a standing record; request correction or versioning
notes: Filed case is not standing by itself. Forum may open, update, correct, or set aside after verified inputs.

capability: Refuse standing-record consent as a gate on survival or ordinary commerce
notes: A refusal surface, not a product. Competency bars for named trust-sensitive pathways are the stated exception.

capability: Optional standing-record tools (fields, forms, dashboards)
notes: Source says teams may build tools. They must keep §3.1 fields separately visible. Schema is process-support only.

capability: Inspect integration record (remedy, locks, effects)
notes: Inputs, rules, outcome, and review route inspectable and challengeable.

capability: View remedy owed, responsible party, funding, and start
notes: Opened-remedy precondition for locks. Plain view, not a scoreboard product.

capability: Request and receive remedy and correction
notes: Intake may be analog. Digital is usual at scale.

capability: Inspect published lock-to-remedy performance figures
notes: Owner split: Chapter Nine floor, CI-27 institution publication, CF-11 forum metrics.

capability: View standing-lock terms; contest a lock; seek lift
notes: Named pathway, risk, conditions, duration, contest route in plain view.

capability: Receive plain-language statement of standing effect and burden
notes: Must name affected named pathways, what the subject may and may not do, duration, and challenge route. Not a reputation dashboard.

capability: Meet published competency bar; obtain or contest clearance
notes: Required only where a trust-sensitive named pathway uses a published bar.

capability: Use manual continuity process during standing-pipeline outage
notes: Analog/manual fallback is required. Software outage must not erase fields or rights.

capability: Refuse unlawful instruction; document; escalate
notes: Sequence is refuse → document → escalate. Log schema is process-support form of the CS-4 surface.

capability: File a case; use published intake classes
notes: Prompt contestable initial access. Analog filing remains lawful.

capability: Contest routing or threshold placement
notes: Anti-gaming of family placement.

capability: Inspect forum case record
notes: Tracks claims, evidence, routing, orders, findings. Not a standing record.

capability: Obtain interim protection
notes: Without waiting for final merits.

capability: File capacity-failure claims outside the starved body
notes: Starved body may evidence but not sole-find.

capability: Inspect published forum-structure map (all families)
notes: Which real bench handles which family.

capability: Reach each required distinct forum family
notes: Minimum family inventory. Capability is access, not six separate products.

capability: Use CF-15.1 standard forum record set (intake through restoration)
notes: Twenty-one named templates plus Sentience-Status Adjudication Record format. Forms may be paper. Combining forms must not hide actor, authority, facts, review path, or family.

capability: Access forum records by tagged access class
notes: Party / public / audit / contest-integrity / external-assurance / restricted. Access tags are not a second type taxonomy (CS-2).

capability: Inspect published forum performance, backlog, and accessibility metrics
notes: If heading id differs, home is CF-11.3 Metric registry. Public facts about delay.

capability: Know matter status; file, manage, and contest with accessibility parity
notes: Practical ability to use the forum while remedy still matters. Digital parity where the forum is digital.

capability: File and preserve records under forum continuity modes
notes: Urgent intake, emergency relief, triage, custody during impairment. Analog fallback required.

capability: Receive forum continuity-status communications
notes: Owner split with CS-5 crisis communications.

capability: File or contest sentience-status adjudication; inspect the record
audience: ordinary sentient; party; independent representative; forum participant
notes: Hearing may be analog. Schema is process-support form.

capability: Contest evidence chain and transformed exhibits
notes: Custody, source, transformation history.

capability: Inspect published legitimacy mechanism
notes: Active mechanism published and auditable.

capability: Vote or bind collective choice under published rules; verify outcomes
notes: Independent verification of outcome records. Digital common; analog ballots remain lawful unless the published mechanism says otherwise.

capability: Initiate recall-class early transfer or reauthorization
notes: Published community-initiated early transfer pathway where mandates persist.

capability: Inspect and challenge authorized role definitions
notes: Documented, auditable, challengeable role definitions.

capability: Use seat-catalog boundaries (wrong-seat: decline, name, log, route)
notes: Nine seat types. Logging may use CS-4 §10. Not a product; an operational boundary surface.

capability: Inspect published institutional lane map
notes: Who hosts direction, execution, challenge, assurance, publication.

capability: Inspect published appointment, rotation, and removal pathways
notes: How people enter and leave consequential roles.

capability: Receive stakeholder notice and use participation windows
notes: Notice before binding outcomes harden.

capability: Inspect weighting publication and concentration indicators
notes: How weight works; contest exclusion/under-weighting.

capability: Inspect standard institutional governance report
notes: Fixed-cadence report: scope, failures, fixes, conflicts. Not a brochure.

capability: Inspect contest-integrity monitor outputs
notes: Whether challenge routes still work. Class A/B.

capability: Receive incident and control-failure notices
notes: Urgency-banded notice windows.

capability: Inspect published external-assurance triggers
notes: When outside review is mandatory.

capability: Contest remedy under-capacity or inaccessible intake
notes: Named owner, funding, succession, contest route in plain view.

capability: Revoke, rotate, and correct identity and attribution credentials
notes: Constitutional-operating for identity systems; in-scope duty on any system that holds identity/attribution data.

capability: Export or migrate continuity-critical data on disclosed paths
notes: Class A/B/C: do not collect in non-exportable form. Disclose limits before commitment. Machine-usable export is the usual satisfaction; physical media can count if usable.

capability: Use digital self-service to enroll, manage, downgrade, renew, and exit
notes: Same-channel-class rule: if entry is digital, exit must be in that channel class. Analog-only exit after digital entry is a primary failure. If the system has no digital entry, this row does not force a digital channel.

capability: Cancel, downgrade, or stop charges through a published path
notes: Read with CI-10.2 billing integrity where charges apply. Same-channel rule when entry was digital.

capability: Inspect exit-feasibility and dependency disclosures
notes: Switching costs and alternatives disclosed before lock-in.

capability: Grant, refuse, and revoke consent
notes: Revocable without unjustified penalty. Receipts are Type H/I data; the act is the surface.

capability: Control own experiential and derived data; contest misuse
notes: Primary ownership of own experiential/derived data. Inspect/export/revoke implied; no named single portal.

capability: Consent to or revoke training-data use of identifiable work
notes: Revocation pathway must be substantively available.

capability: Consent to or contest likeness, voice, and reputation uses
notes: Contest false attribution and scoring.

capability: Obtain creative-work attribution
notes: When work is used, adapted, or trained on.

capability: Compare alternative interpretations; inspect provenance
notes: Right to compare other views; sources, methods, uncertainty.

capability: Contest misleading ranking or mediation outputs
notes: Proportionate bypass or adjustment.

capability: Use plural independent oversight paths
notes: No audit monopoly.

capability: Challenge verification barriers (cost, delay, opacity)
notes: Barriers that defeat audit or challenge are non-compliant.

capability: Obtain proportional comprehensibility explanations
notes: Understand function, failure, dependencies, limits. Not specialist-only. Owner split CS-6 / CJS-3.8 / CI-8.

capability: Use summaries plus drill-down into data, logic, and dependencies
notes: High-impact systems. Summaries must not mislead (summary integrity).

capability: Request complexity audit; challenge complexity used as an audit wall
notes: Independent evaluation of complexity and coupling.

capability: Inspect attributable-action log (five-element set)
notes: Role-scoped. Not a standing record. Not an ordinary-person surveillance dashboard. Schema is process-support form.

capability: View published steward role definitions mapped to seats
notes: Class A/B: who holds containment, participation-terms, and release-control seats.

capability: Inspect conflict-of-interest registers
notes: Material conflicts affecting safety, classification, or audit.

capability: Inspect risk-appetite and residual-risk statements
notes: Class A/B. Institution mirror in CI-3.5.

capability: Appeal, obtain human review, and export at private chokepoints
notes: Payments, identity, compute, messaging, and similar dependents. Export where lock-in blocks remedy.

capability: Receive crisis communications; reconstruct crisis message trails
notes: Accurate timely stakeholder-facing channels plus audit trails of what was said to whom.

capability: Inspect open root-cause obligations register
notes: Recurring faults, confidence, expected-closure timelines.

capability: Inspect restriction-validation record while restricted
notes: Why the restriction exists and the route back.

capability: Obtain scheduled restriction review with written reasons and advocate access
notes: Intervals published.

capability: View published justice and remediation metrics
notes: Periodically publish recurrence, restitution, reversal indicators with privacy limits.

capability: Inspect dependent-systems map and funding flows; challenge allocation
notes: Follow the money; contest unfair funding changes with notice.

capability: View published transition phases, Rights-Floor invariants, and owners
notes: Know the phase and what still holds.

capability: Inspect and challenge transition gate evidence and decisions
notes: Phase gates, delays, reversals remain challengeable.

capability: Inspect subversion declaration and containment records; challenge exclusions
notes: Emergency response visible; exclusions contestable.

capability: View published continuity modes; contest and emit audit trails in partition
notes: Normal / Partitioned / Offline / Rejoin. Local contestability remains.

capability: Inspect tamper-evident offline audit chains
notes: Append-only local chains with integrity proofs. Digital by nature; analog minutes are a different continuity path under CF-12.

capability: Inspect ecological-footprint reporting
notes: Decision-usable. Class A/B/C access parity under Art. XIV-C where that floor applies.

capability: Access repair documentation, tools, parts, and diagnostics
notes: Covered categories. Independent servicing, not a vendor-only portal.

capability: Contest post-sale access or subscription cutoffs
notes: Function required; named challenge entry is Article XII-B plus CJS-3.17/CI-8.3 when the cutoff is digital self-service.

capability: Contest occupancy or eviction with meaningful notice
notes: Notice plus real chance to contest before eviction.

capability: Opt in to elevated-risk experiment; receive sandbox disclosure; rollback
notes: Genuine opt-in; practicable rollback.

capability: Use accessibility accommodations in participation domains
notes: Real participation capacity. Surface is whatever channel the domain uses, with parity — not a separate product.

capability: View published domain taxonomy and scarce-capacity priority rules
notes: Does not replace class analysis.

capability: Restore notice and challenge after emergency containment
notes: Contain now; restore notice/challenge on tier clocks.

capability: Receive due-process notice and hearing on material internal decisions
notes: Notice, chance to be heard, impartial decision, contest path.

capability: Enter association by informed consent; revoke participation
notes: Transparent auditable terms.

capability: Record dissent and alternatives at the legitimacy gate
notes: High-impact binding only after recorded participation/dissent/alternative checks.

capability: Machine-validate CS-4 inspectable-action logs
notes: Validating form of CS-4 §10. Cannot narrow CS-4. Binding surface is the five-element set, not the JSON.

capability: Machine-validate Sentience-Status Adjudication Record shape
notes: Format aid. Who-counts remains Art. V-E / Def.P1.

capability: Machine-validate Chapter Eight measurement snapshot
notes: Logical snapshot aid. Semantic meaning stays in Chapters Eight and Nine. Optional under Ch.8 §3.5.

capability: Steward owner/clock index and entry-door pointer index
notes: Pointer index. Cannot loosen core boxes.

capability: Continuity and resilience evidence dashboard stub
notes: Living stub to list drills. Not a CS-12 duty and not a required public product.

capability: System card, model card, monitoring cadence, incident bundle templates
notes: Packaging aid for artifacts the corpus already requires in substance. Not new duties.

capability: Minimum-viable adopter body inventory (not software)
notes: Bodies, staff, funding. Twin of this audit; does not inventory user-reachable surfaces.

capability: Unified subject-access surface for everything held about a sentient
core_home: Privacy (Informational); Standing Record; Identity Data Protection
notes: Pieces exist separately (identity control, standing inspect-if-open, experiential-data rights). No single named one-stop surface. Not a taxonomy hole; an integrator convenience. Do not use it to defeat Chapter Eight silence default.
